audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors, one of them harmful. (a) Cull the Meek is repeatedly called a dash — 'fury off his Q dash', 'he will dash through you with Q', 'Q dashes across the wave', 'dashing through with Q' — and once called a three-hit ability. (b) wants.you[0] tells you to raise Soul Furnace BEFORE the trade 'so his empowered-W stun deals into your barrier instead of raw HP'.
audit.why: Cull the Meek (Q, 7s, 325 range) is a swing around himself that damages and heals; Slice and Dice (E, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10) is the dash. The three-slash version is empowered Ruthless Predator. And empowered Ruthless Predator explicitly DESTROYS DAMAGE SHIELDS on the target — pre-shielding is the worst possible response, because the shield is the first thing he deletes.
audit.corrected: Dash credited to Slice and Dice; shield advice inverted to hold Soul Furnace until after the empowered stun resolves.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Renekton, Skill, Sion, Sion, Renekton, Sion, Sion in both layers — it gave Sion levels 3 through 5 against a champion whose own text on this page says those are his strongest stages.
audit.why: The packet chart is Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Sion and the mirror has already flipped exactly these rows (levels 2, 3 and 4-5 to Renekton; first item to Skill; level 6 kept Renekton).
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped as matched pairs in both layers, ratings moved to follow.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] claims an empowered Ruthless Predator every 13 seconds.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16/14/12/10/8 — 16 at rank 1, not 13. Cull the Meek is a flat 7s, Dominus 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: 16 seconds at rank 1 written into wants.foe[0] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds appears only in the full layer's itemization line, nowhere in the lane advice.
audit.why: Cull the Meek heals off every swing and heals more above 50 Fury — extended trades are decided by whether anti-heal is online, which is exactly what the missing-interactions entry flags.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing added to whys[2] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The auto-attack reset on Ruthless Predator was never mentioned.
audit.why: The reset auto's wind-up, not the ability cast, is the visible start of his combo — that is the cue to step back.

edits.before: His empowered-W (Ruthless Predator) at 50 fury is a 1.5-second stun at level 1 — charge Q behind the wave only, not in his face, or he walks up with Q fury and punishes the telegraph.
edits.after: Empowered Ruthless Predator at 50 Fury is a 1.5-second stun that also destroys your shield — charge Q behind the wave only, never in his face, or the telegraph is free for him.

edits.before: He generates fury off his Q dash and empowered-W procs almost instantly at level 2 — W shield every approach and only fight after his fury dumps below 50.
edits.after: He builds Fury with Cull the Meek and dashes in with Slice and Dice, so empowered W arrives fast — shield every approach and fight only under 50 Fury.

edits.before: His three-hit Q (Cull the Meek) heals him through your charged-Q trade at level 3 — absorb with W shield, then counter-engage on his fury downtime rather than trying to out-damage him clean.
edits.after: Cull the Meek is a 7-second AoE swing that heals him through your charged-Q trade — bring Grievous Wounds, absorb with Soul Furnace, and counter-engage on his Fury downtime.

edits.before: Renekton's empowered-W (Ruthless Predator) at full fury is a 1.5-second stun that wipes out your W shield and chunks a third of your HP — the whole early lane is built around him hitting this.
edits.after: Empowered Ruthless Predator at 50 Fury stuns 1.5 seconds and DESTROYS Soul Furnace outright — do not open a trade by shielding, because the shield is the first thing he eats.

edits.before: Renekton's levels 1-3 are the strongest point of this lane, and you need to respect that honestly. His Q (Cull the Meek) lets him dash through you for healing and fury generation, and once he hits 50 fury his empowered W (Ruthless Predator) delivers a 1.5-second stun that will burn through your Soul Furnace shield and take a serious chunk of HP. Do NOT charge your Q in the open at level 1 — the telegraph is too long and he will dash through you with Q before the slam connects. Start W, absorb one trade safely with the shield, and accept the lane is his until you have more levels. At level 3, you can begin to fight back: charge your Q behind the wave or from brush angles, force him to either eat the knockup or dash forward — if he dashes in, cancel the charge and activate your W shield to eat his combo, then re-engage immediately when his fury is spent.
edits.after: Renekton's levels 1-3 are the strongest point of this lane, and you need to respect that honestly. Cull the Meek (Q, 7s) swings around him for damage and healing while building Fury, and Slice and Dice (E) is the dash that closes the gap. Once he reaches 50 Fury his empowered Ruthless Predator stuns for 1.5 seconds and destroys Soul Furnace outright — shielding into it hands him the shield for free. Do NOT charge your Q in the open at level 1; the telegraph is too long and he dashes straight through it. Start W, absorb one trade, and accept the lane is his until you have levels. Watch his auto-attack wind-up rather than the ability icon, because Ruthless Predator resets his attack and that wind-up is the real start of the combo. At level 3 you can fight back: charge from brush, and re-engage the moment his Fury is spent.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still his window but the all-in threat diminishes — his kit is fully online but his damage doesn't scale with items the way yours does. Keep your W ready on every approach and never fight into a fury bar above 50. At level 6, Renekton hits his final spike with Dominus (R) — the bonus HP and AOE aura make his all-in genuinely lethal if you're low, so respect it and back off if your HP is below 40%. Your level 6 Unstoppable Onslaught (R) is primarily a threat tool here: use it to threaten roams or to gap-close if he overextends in the open, not as a direct engage into his R. If you survive to the first Heartsteel proc, the lane begins to tip — you are now harder to kill than he is in a prolonged brawl.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still his window but the all-in threat diminishes — his kit is fully online but his damage doesn't scale with items the way yours does. Hold Soul Furnace for after his stun resolves rather than before it, and never fight into a Fury bar above 50; Ruthless Predator is 16 seconds at rank 1. Buy Grievous Wounds early, because Cull the Meek heals him through every extended trade. At level 6 Renekton hits his final spike with Dominus (R) — bonus HP and an AOE aura make his all-in lethal if you are low, so back off below 40%. Your Unstoppable Onslaught is a threat tool here: roam pressure or a gap-close if he overextends, not a direct engage into his R. Survive to the first Heartsteel proc and the lane begins to tip.

edits.before: Stack your W shield (Soul Furnace) before each trade so his empowered-W stun deals into your barrier instead of raw HP
edits.after: Hold Soul Furnace until after his empowered stun lands — cast early and Ruthless Predator simply destroys it

edits.before: Generate fury quickly with Q dashes across the wave and auto-cancels to enable empowered-W (Ruthless Predator) all-ins every 13 seconds
edits.after: Build Fury with Cull the Meek on the wave, then Slice and Dice in for an empowered Ruthless Predator every 16 seconds at rank 1

edits.before: Punish any charged-Q telegraph by dashing through with Q before the slam connects and immediately responding with W stun
edits.after: Punish any charged-Q telegraph with a Slice and Dice through you, then answer with the Ruthless Predator stun

notes: The shield-destruction fact reverses the page's opening advice, not just its wording: the old wants.you[0] told the player to pre-shield into the one ability in Renekton's kit that deletes shields. Level 6 is kept as Renekton in both layers even though the packet chart says Skill — that is the mirror's deliberate decision (Dominus versus an immobile Sion is the stated kill window) and both layers already agreed on it, so I did not disturb it. Full-layer prose fields carry mojibake em-dashes on disk and were left untouched.
